items.source: By default, @RestControllerAdvice applies to any controller, including @Controller and @RestController. Use attributes of the annotation to apply more specific filtering criteria.
items.translation: 默认情况下，@RestControllerAdvice 适用于任何控制器，包括 @Controller 和 @RestController。使用该注解的属性来应用更具体的过滤条件。

items.source: See ControllerAdvice for more details.
items.translation: 有关详细信息，请参阅ControllerAdvice。

items.source: Allows for more concise annotation declarations — for example, @RestControllerAdvice("org.my.pkg") is equivalent to @RestControllerAdvice(basePackages = "org.my.pkg").
items.translation: 允许使用更简洁的注解声明——例如，`@RestControllerAdvice("org.my.pkg")` 等价于 `@RestControllerAdvice(basePackages = "org.my.pkg")`。

items.source: Controllers that belong to those base packages or sub-packages thereof will be included — for example, @RestControllerAdvice(basePackages = "org.my.pkg") or @RestControllerAdvice(basePackages = {"org.my.pkg", "org.my.other.pkg"}).
items.translation:
属于这些基础包或其子包的控制器将被包含在内——例如，
`@RestControllerAdvice(basePackages = "org.my.pkg")` 或
`@RestControllerAdvice(basePackages = {"org.my.pkg", "org.my.other.pkg"})`。

items.source: Controllers that are assignable to at least one of the given types will be advised by the @RestControllerAdvice annotated class.
items.translation: 可以被分配给给定类型之一的控制器将由带有 `@RestControllerAdvice` 注解的类进行增强。

items.source: Controllers that are annotated with at least one of the supplied annotation types will be advised by the @RestControllerAdvice annotated class.
items.translation: 由至少一个提供的注解类型标注的控制器将由带有 `@RestControllerAdvice` 注解的类进行增强。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages in which to select controllers to be advised by the @RestControllerAdvice annotated class.
items.translation: 用于指定要由 `@RestControllerAdvice` 注解的类建议的控制器所在的包的 `basePackages()` 的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: value() is an alias for this attribute, simply allowing for more concise use of the annotation.
items.translation: value() 是该属性的别名，仅允许更简洁地使用此注解。

items.source: Also consider using basePackageClasses() as a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 此外，还可以考虑使用 `basePackageClasses()` 作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Consider creating a custom composed annotation or use a predefined one, like @RestController.
items.translation: 考虑创建自定义组合注解或使用预定义的注解，例如@RestController。

items.source:
Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package
that serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。
